title: NASA telepathy experiments and remote viewing the moon

tellings.quote: So he he claims that they sent remote viewers to the moon

plain: In the 1960s the US space agency NASA is said to have run telepathy experiments, and the researcher Andrija Puharich claimed they sent remote viewers, people who try to see distant places with the mind alone, to the moon. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells this, pointing to newspaper articles and to Puharich's NASA contracts. If true, it would mean the space agency took mind powers seriously.
